item.title: Vegan Thanksgiving Lentil Loaf
item.description: I’ve always loved meat loafs, so I decided to make a vegan version that uses cooked lentils instead of ground meat. It’s really easy to make, it’s high in fiber and protein and most of all it’s incredibly DELICIOUS!! Try this recipe of Vegan Thanksgiving lentil loaf with a mashed pumpkin and sweet potato casserole with a nut-oat topping, vegan gravy, and cranberry pear sauce today.

item.title: Vegan Black Bean Brownies
item.description: They’re not only super delicious but also really fudgy and chocolatey. Plus the recipe really couldn’t be easier! All you need is a food processor or blender, an oven, and a handful of ingredients such as brown beans, cacao, and vegan chocolate chips. I’m sure people would never guess that these brownies contain black beans instead of flour.

item.title: Toxins And How Our Body Eliminates Them
item.description: Toxins are chemicals they cause harm to the body's cells, organs, and everyday functions. There are two main groups of toxins: exotoxins and endotoxins. Exotoxins are from outside sources and are inhaled or ingested. Examples are polluted air, water, cigarette smoke, alcohol, medications, food additives and household chemicals.

item.title: 9 Alkaline Foods to Add for Optimal Health
item.description: Our bodies need to have a balanced pH so that our health is at an optimal level. However, when one’s balance is disrupted by consuming excessive amounts of acidic foods, the risk of serious health problems like inflammation, toxic deposits, poor immunity, and vulnerable organs is much higher. This being said, we decided to share a list with the 9 best alkaline foods to restore the balance in your body and preserve your well-being.
